description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A broad circular bamboo ring surrounds an open center and wrapped woven segments. Side: The ring has a raised double-hoop profile on three low feet. Rear: The rear and underside reveal radial connecting ribs between both hoops. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. One low circular POT TRIVET lying FLAT HORIZONTALLY, like a shallow ring parallel to the studio floor. It has a broad open center, two concentric bamboo hoops and a woven band connecting them. EXACTLY THREE tiny equally spaced feet attach to its UNDERSIDE and point DOWN to the floor, raising the horizontal ring only a little. They are not three decorative legs pointing outward from an upright circle. No upright display pose, no vertical arch, no tall stand. Style Boho: organic graceful curves and restrained craft detail. Relative size compact within its class. Woven surface: open square lattice made from wider flat strips. Finish: cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Canonical FRONT camera azimuth zero, centered straight in front of the long/broad front edge, with a modest downward elevation so the top woven surface is visible. Preserve the natural horizontal resting orientation. Whole product, generous margins, no measurements, no props, no text anywhere. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
